title: Wave 1 repositories: reach seven services and start GitHub indexing
notes: Every flag stays off. This step introduces code references and starts the GitHub indexing clock; it changes no targeting.

demo-pricing and demo-shipping are created and committed but deliberately not deployed: their flags exist with source references and no callers, which is the first stage of the lifecycle the talk describes.

Deployment rotates rather than grows. The cap is twelve simultaneous evaluator containers and the stack is already at twelve, so demo-storefront and demo-profile drop their non-critical Test and Dev evaluators to make room. Production and Staging stay up for all three pre-campaign services, so no critical-environment evidence is interrupted.
demo-orders keeps all four environments because it carries the bounded Production load probe and its history must remain continuous.
